admissibility_gates.g1_provenance_hashed: every source parquet sha256 recorded in the ingest manifest; license cc-by-4.0; unauthenticated access
admissibility_gates.g2_instruments_ge_5: at least 5 coins with >=1 observed liquidation event in the window
admissibility_gates.g3_complete_months_ge_3: at least 3 calendar months with <=20% candle gap for every coin
admissibility_gates.g5_observed_labels_only: no modeled/proxy/estimated liquidation column present; main-dex perps only
admissibility_gates.g6_alignment_yield_ge_95pct: >=95% of observed liquidation events join to an existing candle hour

alignment_protocol.funding_join: floor funding timestamp to hour; join on (coin, hour)
alignment_protocol.label_aggregation: per (coin, hour): liq_count, liq_long_count, liq_short_count, liq_fills, liq_notional_usd
alignment_protocol.open_interest_join: floor OI timestamp to hour; join on (coin, hour)
alignment_protocol.target_join: floor event timestamp to hour (UTC ms since epoch); join on (coin, hour)
alignment_protocol.tolerance: floor-to-hour only; no cross-hour forward fill for labels

confirmatory_not_registered_reason: execution window limited to cached 2025-11..2026-04; confirmatory registration requires the 2026-05..2026-10 bulk extension plus a re-run of this frozen audit
fills_role: fills parquet available in the dataset but not required for label counts; not ingested in this session

label_construction.dedupe_rule: drop exact duplicate rows on (tx_hash, wallet, market, timestamp)
label_construction.definition: observed Hyperliquid perpetual forced-liquidation event row; one row = one liquidation
label_construction.normalization: raw USD notional plus per-hour counts; no OI/volume normalization applied to the label itself
label_construction.venue_filter: dex == '' and market_class == 'perp' and market in {COIN}-PERP

missingness_rules: absence from the feed is never treated as evidence of no liquidation
hours without a candle are excluded from the panel, not imputed
reporting caps and collector gaps are declared limits, not estimated away
terms: CC BY 4.0; attribution to ironflow; no requester-pays, no API key, no signature
